_sources.listing: Google Business Profile, read in the user's own Chrome via Claude in Chrome (2026-11-28): 'PMB Carpentry and Construction', 5.0 stars, 5 reviews (all 5 stars), category 'Carpenter', 'Open 24 hours', phone +61 468 565 397 (matches the sheet), no website ('Add website'). Drawn service areas: Toowoomba, Warwick, and a large area from Caboolture through Brisbane and Ipswich to the Gold Coast. Cover photo: a hardwood deck with a timber screen. Review topics: reliability 3, quality of work 2.
_sources.services: From reviews: deck, sunshade and pool fencing built to the customer's design, on time and within the contracted budget; repeat carpentry jobs for several customers. Owner named Peter in reviews.
_sources.brand: No brand online. Sampled from their Google listing cover photo (merbau-coloured hardwood deck) with scripts/sample-brand.mjs, adjusted by eye: primary = merbau #94502a (white 6.1:1), dark = #2b1a10 (white 16.7:1), accent = timber #e7b97e (9.3:1 on dark). Sampled from their listing photo, not an official brand; confirm with the owner. Concept mark (PMB lettering) is original.
_sources.reviews: Google Reviews tab, same session: 5 reviews, all 5 stars; 3 complete ones copied verbatim (Nilantha Karunarathna: deck/sunshade/pool fencing, Lauren R: repeat jobs, Holly H: repeat customer).

gap: No website: 5.0 stars on Google and a service area from Toowoomba to the Gold Coast, but 'Add website' on the listing, so homeowners can only ring; there's no way to send deck plans or photos and ask for a quote.

realReviews.author: Nilantha Karunarathna
realReviews.text: Perter is a good bloke. Work seamlessly with us to build our dream deck, sunshade, and complete fool fencing. Peter reads design and our imagination well and executes work on a plan. Complete all work on time and within budget as agreed on in the contract. We hire him again if the opportunity exists to complete carpentry work in future. Wish you all the bast mate.

realReviews.author: Lauren R
realReviews.text: Peter is an extremely hard working professional, who has great attention to detail. He is fairly priced and is very reliable. I have used Peter a few times now, and his work has always been completed efficiently and to an excellent standard. He is also very friendly and easy to get along with. I will continue to use and recommend his services. Keep up the good work Peter.

realReviews.author: Holly H
realReviews.text: I will always be a repeat customer. Peter’s work is to the highest of standards, he is efficient and always a delight to deal with. Well done to Peter, trades aren’t always so easy. Love your work and service.

finalCta.headline: Planning a deck or carpentry job?
finalCta.body: Send your plans or a few photos, or pick a time to talk it through. You'll get a clear quote before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight answer.

faq.q: Can you build to my own design?
faq.a: Yes. Send your plans or ideas and we'll work out how to build them.
Yes. Pool fencing can be done as part of a deck or outdoor build.
Toowoomba and Warwick, plus Ipswich, Brisbane and the Gold Coast. Ask if you're unsure.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to Peter, you get a text and email confirmation, and he follows up to talk through the job.
